nom: Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads

avis.texte: First: This is a very inexpensive method thet is worth a try for anyone. It has so many pads in one box, so ive used it for a while now and will be reordering a few backups. I like to keep track of changes to my routine. Since i did this, and i use a few wipes at a time, a few time a week, cause the price allows it, ive noticed better eventoned skin that looks like my 20-something self, eithout any irritation whstsoever. I use the scrubby sife after to kind of get ar nose pores but there is something about this base formula that seems to work miracles. (Also, ill note, i tried all sorts of anti-dark spot stuff in my 20s and it was such a waste of money).
I read about this product and decided to try it. My skin tone is evening out and appears more radiant and glowy, not oily.
The Rael Carotene Toner Pads are a daily must-have for me. They gently smooth and refresh my skin while giving it a healthy glow. My complexion has never looked this clear and radiant!
It's easy to use and feels really nice. My only complaint is that the top feels a little flimsy; the whole thing comes off about as easily as just the latched part.
Was super excited to try this for my acne scars and redness but unfortunately it made my skin SUPER irritated.

Wow first off the packaging was amazing in itself. I will definitely be reusing this cute square box. Sealed fresh and it also comes with mini tongs so you don't have to dip in your fingers. They thought of it all. Okay. The product. No perfume smell and is safe on my sensitive skin which I love. A soft side to wipe for a couple of minutes that feels like a quick face mask almost in application. Then the other side which is textured to exfoliate. Didnt break me out, left my skin very soft. Great for newbies in skincare or the 10 step guys and gals. My skin is softer and brighter in just a week! A plus is it's cruelty free and I will definitely be repurchasing.
This product wasn't the greatest. I didn't see a lot of change of my skin with this product

Usually every single product makes me breakout like crazy. My skin is super sensitive and gets little bumps that I have been having trouble getting to go away. I use these every night and my face feels AMAZING after and by the morning still. It hydrates so well, my skin is usually combo but this product just works so well for me. I highly recommend giving these a try, my friends and family have tried this based on my recommendation as well and have also had great results. I want to try more of their products in the future!

I have acne prone skin, currently under control but I still get the occasional hormonal acne. I am pretty strict with my skin routine and this has fit perfectly into it. I use it every other night, adapalene when I'm not using this. I have had great results, doesn't irritate my skin and brightens my skin. I scar frequently, after 2 weeks of using the pads, I noticed a difference.
The pads left my skin soft & glowy. My skin felt hydrated and firm.

My skin is not sensitive by any means but these pads broke my face out incredibly bad. I love the container and the cute pincher to grab the pads but this isn't something I'd use again due to the breakout.
I loved how easy it is to use and how my skin looks like after a couple weeks using.

I've tried sheet masks before and have loved them but they are restricting on the face and it seems like you can only wear them while laying down. These fragrance free brightening carotene pads intrigued me because you are able to spot treat due to the smaller size! My sensitive skin appreciates when products are made fragrance free < 3 These brightening carotene pads were moisturizing and mess free while also not making my skin angry. I do feel more radiant when I take them off.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I was a bit hesitant to try the product as I am prone to problematic skin when I try a new product… however, I have had NO issues with this product! My skin looks bright and smooth. Highly recommend!

I love the packaging and generous amount of Tonner pads it holds. Small plastic clipper is provided to pick the pads hygienically- square size of the pads are very convenient to place on specific treatment area if needed. Rael's Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads are dual-sided for perfect use. One side has gentle texture cotton to exfoliate and wipe away makeup or any dirt on the skin. The other side is softer, cushion feeling with cold gel to hydrate skin immediately. The Gel side can be used as quick mask sheet (5-10 minutes). It gives this glowy, hydrated and radiant skin right after the use of these Miracle tonner pads. I use these in the morning and especially on my long makeup day as a mask sheet to hydrate my skin. I have combination skin and my skin loves these tonner pads!

I used it both ways; swiping all over to give a quick treatment and also tried leaving the squares on my face for 10-15 mins. I prefer the squares left on like a mask. My skin was nice and hydrated and felt soft. Gave me a nice glow.

I love everything about this product. Very cool box and cute little tweezers to pick up each square. This feels so nice going on. Glides over the face so smoothly and the textured side sweeps away what's leftover. Can't tell a huge difference in my skin yet, as it's only been a couple of weeks but I have very high hopes for this one. My skin just feels so nice while using this. Will definitely have to get another one of these.

The brightening pads give my skin a wake up, brightening and soothing. The pads are a little hard to manage because there is so much product on them, but the tweezers included with the packaging make it easy to grab and separate them. I like that you can use the product 2 ways- let it sit longer for a masking effect or if you are in a rush a quick swipe. I've done both and both feel great. However, I will personally stick to a more traditional brightening serum as I don't love the waste associated with the single use pads.

I received this product from bzz agent in exchange for my honest review. I really like the double sided brightening pads. I exfoliate with one side and smooth and brighten with the other. This product makes my face feel clean, soft,smooth. The only thing I dont like is the product does leak out of the container and the product has a unpleasant scent to it that I do not like.
Love these toner pads! I use these after cleansing and before using any serum. They adsorb quickly and leave skin refreshed and glowing!
I tried these pads as a mask as well as a toner and my skin was so radiant after using it, it came with little thongs to avoid contamination, overall I would repurchase
These pads leave my skin looking brighter and smoother. They are easy to use and can be used everyday as a toner or longer as a mask. I would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a toner

avis.titre: Awesome packaging, good for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love products that have a nice presentation. The packaging is nice and eye catching. It looks good as part of my skin care collection. The pads are small and have a gel feel on one side that is soothing. The other side is textured. I have very sensitive skin and I had no irritation. I use this daily or every other day. I have melasma on both cheeks and work daily to even my skin. I've seen minor improvement and hope to see better results after 30 days
It's okay for me. It left my skin dryer than it already is. This might be good for someone with combination to oily skin type. This is a no for me.

The Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads are an interesting product. The product is easy to open, I love the case they come in. There is very minimal smell. I didn't experience any irritation using them and my skin felt good. I don't believe I've been using them long enough to see any solid results to report on. All that said, it a little weird to use. You use one side of the pad to apply the gel and then it's either supposed to sit or you're supposed to apply it for 2-3 minutes— the instructions are not clear. It says "On cleansed skin, apply gel infused side on cheeks and forehead for 2-3 minutes" does that mean I do that for 2-3 mins, which seems like a long time and there's not that much gel, or so I apply it and let it sit? Which also means then, I have to sit the pad down because the next step is to use the textured side to wipe across entire face. So I either hold the pad for 2-3 min and then flip it or sit it down— which doesn't seem sanitary?? I would assume they want you to apply it to your face for 2-3 mins but that's a long time to wipe a pad on cheeks and forehead.
Love the packaging - the product didn't dry out at all after using regularly. I could definitely see a difference in the tone of my skin. Would definitely purchase.

I really like the dual texture pads for a refreshing feeling. I really appreciate that it has 8 types of hyaluronic acid. This is an ingredient I've bought on its own so to get that with niacinamide plus even more ingredients makes this a high value product to me.

I used these twice in a week and received compliments on my skin! I can't attribute it solely to this product but I have my suspicions. These pads feel cooling and soothing on the skin. I didn't experience any sensitivity or irritation, and they helped clear up some stubborn hormonal breakouts on my jawline. I'm very interested in trying more products.

These carotene pads are very hydrating & will stay on your face while you let your skin soak them up. I have used others pads that aren't moist enough & just fall off. These have brightened my skin & the packaging is cute too! There's a lot of pads in here & will be lasting awhile. I would recommend!

I use these Carotene pads every night & so far they're great! I take one pad after cleansing & apply all over my face as a toner. Haven't had any irritation & they absorb nicely into the skin. There is no scent which is a plus for me. You can also use the pads as a mask. Can't wait to see the long term results!

I had the orange package. I use this product daily before bed, but I am used to using AHAs, so you might need to start off slow if you're new to AHA. I swiped all over my face and let sink in before going in with the rest of my skin care. I do feel like my dark spots have lightened and my skin has an overall glow. The large package comes with some tweezers to hygienically grab a sheet. I have not used as a mask, but I think simply swiping over my face worked well. I will continue to use this product.
Gentle to use, love that it's fragrance free. Makes skin smooth right after, need to use it longer for the brightening effects. There's a small tweezer included on the lid.

Absolutely loved the package design and quality of this product. Pads are very moist and worked well, definitely enjoyed using and delivered excellent moisture to skin that absorbed nicely without a sticky feeling after.

These combination pads are excellent! I love how bright and healthy my face feels. I appreciate that these are smaller so I am not committed to a full face mask, but instead get the benefits of one. I would highly recommend.

**I'm reviewing these in exchange of getting them to try for free** They work so well. My skin glows and feels smooth! They helped lighten my dark spots from previous acne blemishes which is amazing. I have very sensitive skin and these do not cause me any irritation at all! I definitely recommend them. I will continue to purchase after I use my free ones up. :)

I enjoyed these pads - the serum is very nice and I liked using the textured pad after resting with the smooth side on my skin for a few moments. My only complaint is that the size of the pads make them slightly awkward to use them as a mask

avis.titre: It feels really refreshing—I love how smooth it glides on!
avis.texte: Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads Review Hi there! I got this amazing MIRACLE CLEAR—BRIGHTENING CAROTENE PADS, for free from Rael Beauty to try it and give my honest review—.These are supposed to be amazing for brightening the skin. (Just right for me). I've been incorporating them into my morning and night skincare routine since the first day I got them.The packaging is sleek and the pads are easy to use. They are pre-soaked, making it convenient for both morning and night applications. The texture of the pads is soft but effective, allowing for gentle exfoliation without irritation. I appreciate that the formula is infused with carotene, which feels gentle yet effective, even for sensitive skin.The pads also seemed to help smooth my skin's texture, particularly in areas where I usually have rough patches. Using it is super easy—actually you can do it in three ways: after cleanser, you can just swipe it across your face, or you can put the pads on your face and leave there for a few minutes, or just folder and put over any specific spot. Overall, they're meant to help with dullness and uneven skin tone.It is Gentle on the skin, convenient, and easy to incorporate into my routine. After using them for seven days, I noticed a visible brightening effect on my skin. My complexion looks more even, and there

The container and small tweezers is awesome. I don't care for the solution on pads. It left my face sticky feeling like I put sunscreen on. It did not break my skin out but pads are extremely wet which is great too.
This actually works so well for my skin. The formula is so hydrating. Just after one use you see the difference. The ingredients ate so good.

I have sensitive skin with some sun damage. I can't see big difference in terms of sun spots but my skin definitely feels softer and smoother after use. I like that pads have two sides and exfoliating side is pretty gentle. Packaging is also very simple and tasteful. Bonus point, it is made in Korea, and I have never had bad experience with Korean skincare.

avis.titre: Rael has truly created a game-changer with these 2 in 1 pads
avis.texte: Thanks to Rael for kindly sending me the Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads for free so I can review it. I recently tried the Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads, and I can't recommend them enough ! These pads are incredibly easy and quick to use, they come in pre-soaked toner, so it makes my skincare routine even easier. Rael has truly created a thoughtfully designed product with the added plastic tweezers that attach to the lid making grabbing the pads effortless and sanitary, which is such a nice touch! I've been on the hunt for a product that helps minimize the dark spots along my chin left from hormonal acne. Since incorporating these pads into my routine, I've noticed a significant reduction in the discoloration along my chin. Rael's Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads really do deliver on their promise of brightening the skin. The nourishing formula feels amazing on my skin, and I love that they have a textured side for gentle exfoliation, making these pads a two-in-one solution. If you're looking for a simple solution to brighten your skin and minimize imperfections, I highly recommend giving these pads a try!
I used this product at night as I use a vitamin c serum during the day. It has helped my skin feel fresh and clean. This has also been very hydrating which is a big plus as it makes my skin glowy.

avis.titre: Best Brightening Pads I've ever used.
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest and fair reviews. First let me say I'm a skincare junkie and I've used a handful of toning pads and this one is hands down my favorite and I will definitely be buying more when I finish using this one. I've been using this toner pads for over two weeks and I see a difference in the texture of my skin, it's softer and feels cleaner. Also it has helped with reducing the breakouts on my face (in conjunction with other products). So far I haven't had any bad reactions to this product and there are really no cons. I definitely recommend this product and think that you should give it a try

I recently received these pads to sample and give my honest review. I do like how the pads are packaged. Keeps each pad "wet", rather than them drying out over time. As I've gotten older, I've noticed my skin is becoming more dehydrated and in need of more moisture. And the appearance of my skin just seems to be more "imbalanced". I have used these pads for over a week, and can say I have noticed a difference in the overall appearance of my skin. The uneven skin tones seem to have minimized, and my skin feels more hydrated as well. I have used them for a quick "toning" and exfoliator, and also have left them on my face for a bit to give my skin the extra nourishment. I love that these pads include eight types of Hyaluronic Acid, which my skin definitely is in need of now that I'm older. And that they have a multi use option. I am also one who has sensitivity issues at times with skin care, and I did not experience any issues with these pads. Overall, I would recommend these pads to anyone who's skin is in need of an extra boost of hydration, and looking to even out skin tone.

I used this product for 2 weeks to give an accurate review as this was sent to me in exchange for my review. I'm sooo glad I used it consistently! My chin gets hormonal acne and due to that I also get dark spots and discoloration there too. I used a pad every night after washing my face and it has made such a difference in my skin tone!!

I love the feel of this little pad it is kind of slimy but feels hydrating straight away. I like it comes with little tweezers to pick up the pads and keep them clean. The box itself is cute but leaks so I wouldn't be bringing this on a trip with me.

The instructions weren't specific & I didn't know I had flip the pad over for the smooth part so I was rubbing my face on the side face up when you lift from the box. When I used the smooth side first with a new pad it felt good on my skin. It unfortunately wouldn't grip to my skin so when I was trying to wipe it on my pad for the 2-3 minutes recommended it kept folding onto itself. I did notice smoothness after use.
These pads help to tone your skin. I have sensitive skin and it didn't seem to break me out, which is a good sign. The scent is not over powering and it's a quality product.

As someone with sensitive skin, I was worried this product would be too harsh to use daily. It is NOT. The pads feel amazing on my skin and are gentle enough to use everyday! I love the included tweezers to grab the pads - such a cute and beneficial addition! I will definitely be purchasing once I run out! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Of course I add to my routine
avis.texte: I used this product for a couple days and I can see awesome results, obviously I add to my routine and I married with this brand.

avis.titre: The product I didn't know I needed!
avis.texte: I finally caved and tried these - wow! I'm never looking back! These thin sheets are super hydrating and stick to your face easily. I like to wear 2-3 on my cheeks and forehead while i get ready in the morning. I usally wear them for 5-10 minutes and then use the excess to wipe across my entire face like a toner or pre-serum. My skin feels so soft, plump and toned after using. I've had more people comment on my skin looking healthy and glowy since i started using these! Can't recommend enough!

I have been using these toner pads for the past few days. I have a few comments about it: -The packaging is quite nice and sturdy, and feels nice quality -The toner pads themselves have a slightly rough side, and a gel side. I use the gel side to apply the product all over my face, and potentially can use as a mask for patch treatment if needed as well.(i have attached a picture of this) Then i let that sit for a minute or two, and then i use the rougher side to do a quick swipe over the face to get some gentle exfoliation as they have mentioned even in the instructions. -I have not noticed a significant difference in the few days that i have been using the pads, however the pads do have a nice cooling effect, and feel nice and soothing on the skin despite containing so many active ingredients. I didn't experience any itching/burning even on the dry/chapped parts of my skin. So i liked that. Whenever i use glycolic acid it feels like I'm stabbing my face with micro-needles, so I appreciated this. -I think I would like to use them for a fairly long time, because obviously the ingredients are those which need a fair chance rather than just a few days. -Overall, i do like the product a lot, and I feel like it would have positive results upon consistent use.

I like the packaging for this. It's a cool square container and has little tongs inside to pick them up. But I don't really get how the product works. It has a gel infused side and then a textured side for exfoliation. Like how does the gel just not get onto the textured side of the next one? Idk. It is cooling and feels pretty good but I haven't noticed anything.

Love how this product is well package. It had a great seal and came along with a tweezer for sanitize purpose. Love that it doesn't have any fragrance scent as to I'm very sensitive. The pad is very thin but absorbed plenty of moisturizer to cover your face. So I can't complain and will have to use it longer to see results.

I really enjoyed using these Rael brightening carotene pads. They are fun to use, come with a little tweezer, and works to smooth and brighten. I don't have any redness when I use it and it doesn't sting. It's great.
These carotene pads are so convenient to use. Comes in nice packages and cleans and brightens the skin.
The product is very simple to use. I love how moisturizing the product is. I'm hoping to see improvement in my skin tone and dark spots, but I know time will tell. I would buy this again.

avis.titre: 10/10 EXCELLENT!! highly recommend these amazing pads!
avis.texte: First, the PACKAGING is awesome! It comes in such an aesthetic packaging and has little micro tweezers to grab each pad. The product itself is dual purpose, one side to hydrate, one side that's textured to scrub. It made my skin glow, feel like a dream, my makeup applied very well after using it, and it smells SO clean and nice. 10/10 all the way around.

My skin felt smooth and moisturized after using the product, but I could not tell whether my skin was brighter or not. The pad shape was not my favorite because I was not able to cover all areas of my face. I was impressed that the product worked in just 2-3 minutes. Thanks to Rael for the free Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads!
This product has been having my skin glowing and looking so hydrated.

First of all, packaging - I'm obsessed. It's minimal, rectangular/cube, and has a baby tong to help pick up a singular pad (since they stick together) on the lid. Genius! Secondly, these pads feel refreshing and are so easy to use. I see a bit of difference in brightening of my skin and has helped a bit with texture with the AHA. It's a fun and quick way to treat your skin while allowing you to move about as needed.
I received this item so late I wasn't even excited to try it. I instantly felt my skin sooo soft. It seems gimmicky but it's exactly what my skin needed.

New mom here of a baby who prefers to sleep during the day and party at night. My skin has gone through the wringer due to lack of sleep. These really helped to give my skin the pick me up I've been needing! My skin looks less dull and lackluster, and I feel like I have a little bit of life in my face! I would definitely purchase again.

I saw a difference in first use, it feels great and cool on my skin. I do feel like the squares are too big and fit awkwardly on my face, I do believe if they were circles I would like them much better, I also didn't feel much difference on texture for the exfoliating side. Even though I did see a difference on where I placed the squares for a longer period or time rather than just using one to sweep my face. Over all I do like them a lot!

Absolutely love these pads. Skin looks so healthy, clean and fresh after use ! These pads do not irritate my face which is super important. Absolutely highly recommend these pads for everyone that needs a little skin brightening in their life!

This is my first time trying this brightening miracle clear pads and they have been helping my skin. I like how you can easily apply on skin and how it's very light weight. I also like the exfoliation part of the pad really helps clean out skin. This product makes my face feel fresh and healthier. I will continue to use it.
I love it. I feel that it is very functional and very easy to use. My skin feels much softer and brighter. The results are excellent after a few days.

avis.titre: UM wow yes I love it !
avis.texte: Let me start off by saying these pads are AMAZING!! My face looked so clear and bright after using it for a week I will need to keep getting these for sure! It also has dual sides so you can hydrate or flip it to exfoliate, GENIUS!

These pads are both a toner and a an exfoliate. The package has so much liquid so there is no chance of Getting a dry pad. The thickness of the pad is amazing feels so Luxurious. Highly recommend if you want to to see your skin tone brighter.

Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads - Review The Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads are a gentle yet effective addition to my skincare routine. With beta-carotene, they leave my skin smoother and more radiant without irritation. After a couple of weeks, I noticed less redness and fewer breakouts. The pads are soft, non-abrasive, and don't leave any residue. While there's a slight scent, it's not overpowering. Great for brightening and improving skin texture!
These smell amazing! I love how it smells and have been now using it for a while and can see a difference in my skin

Loving the glow that these pads provided. My favorite things about these pads is the amount of moisture in each pad and that they are double sided. The gel like side really creates an experience by soothing your face and allowing your skin to absorb product with friction. The other side is great when I'm on the go. These work!

I got this product in exchange for my review. Used it a few days and so far it's great! No breakouts and my skin feels super smooth and clean after using it. The next day I have a nice glow. The ingredients also look super clean!

Love these pads! I use them at night after cleansing and makes it so easy to ensure I get all my stubborn makeup and leftover dirt from the day off. I used to use the FAB Radiance Pads but these are great and feel very gentle on my sensitive skin yet also being effective. Thank you for the sample and I look forward to purchasing once I run out!
Love this product! Appearance looks so much better after a few uses.
